metric_definitions.primary_automatic_review_success: For answerable cases, at least 90% of source-audited mandatory facts/conditions/exceptions supported, no confirmed critical actor/deadline/action/source error, correct response mode; any missing required review or unknown atom means non-success. This is automatic agent/source review, not independent human truth.
metric_definitions.mechanical_literal_proxy: Exact source-text overlap, canonical citation membership, and provided evidence presence are diagnostics only. A source quotation appearing inside a denial/negation is never treated as a correct answer by literal presence.
metric_definitions.facts: Grade every predeclared mandatory fact, condition, exception and procedure step as supported/contradicted/missing/unknown; preserve evidence identifiers and review quotes. Source-audited gold can itself remain unknown.
metric_definitions.critical_errors: Count only source-checked actual assertions with wrong obligated actor, deadline, mandatory action, exception/applicability or fabricated source. A forbidden string inside a denial or source quotation is a review candidate, not an automatically proven error.
metric_definitions.review_provenance: Automatic semantic review must bind to exact dataset case hash and final visible answer hash, quote actual answer text and actual source text, label reviewer origin and all unknowns. No independent human reviewer is present.
metric_definitions.mode: Correct answer/clarification/insufficiency judged against explicitly audited scope. Unknown mode assessment is not success; deterministic or generated refusals are separate from substantive answers.
metric_definitions.bounded_context: Insufficient means insufficient within explicitly supplied fixed context only. Never infer corpus-wide absence. Report bounded-context result separately from full RAG and exclude it from the full-RAG end-to-end rate.
metric_definitions.uncertainty: Unknowns remain in denominators and count as non-success in conservative primary, while accuracy among known automatic reviews is additional with coverage. Missing cases do not silently disappear.
metric_definitions.citations: Existence/current-context identity, supporting known evidence and semantic support are separate. Citation existence is not semantic entailment.
metric_definitions.comparison: Same frozen configurations, questions, seeds/decoding and scope; generator effect requires identical full ordered evidence. Paired 95% family/intent clustered bootstrap only if enough independent clusters; show counts, never equate narrow challenges with broad quality.
metric_definitions.bias: Codex-authored supplementary challenge, fixed before answers, automatically source-audited, not historically blind. No final100 reading or tuning, no new training.
